name: Tretinoin
description: All-trans retinoic acid, a form of vitamin A acid, used on the skin

note.text: A 2007 trial in 31 men found no significant difference between minoxidil alone and minoxidil plus tretinoin.

bullets: **Exact mode of action** is unknown, per the label
**Follicle-lining cells** stick together less and turn over faster
**Raised minoxidil absorption** through the skin nearly threefold in 19 men
Hair: 1 small study, 1 trial of 31 men

practical.pharmacokinetics: Under 2% absorbed through skin in 7 men (0.05% cream)
practical.soldAs: Prescription cream and gel (Retin-A, Renova, generics)

regulatory.text: Approved for acne and fine wrinkles; not hair loss
Compounded hair sprays are not FDA approved

references: Shin et al., Am J Clin Dermatol, minoxidil vs minoxidil plus tretinoin, 2007
